member.name: T:Winche.Rules.Querying.QueryAnalyzer
member.summary: Decides whether a list query is allowed — Firestore's "rules are not filters": the query is allowed only when its constraints provably guarantee every result satisfies a read rule; otherwise it is rejected (the client must constrain the query). The analysis is sound — it never returns true for a query that isn't provably safe — and intentionally incomplete (it rejects queries it cannot prove, including any rule using get()/exists(), ternaries, in, or per-result path wildcards).
